title: Invariance under gate relabeling
statement: Let $\beta$ be a type, let $f$ assign an output in $\beta$ to each gate and list of previous outputs, and let $h$ map gates to gates. Suppose $f(h(g),v)=f(g,v)$ for every gate $g$ and output list $v$. Then running the gates obtained by applying $h$ to each gate in a list $gs$, starting from an initial output list, gives the same output list as running $gs$ from that initial list.
hypotheses_covered: For every gate and output list, $f(h(g),v)=f(g,v)$
